Allah swears by the angels who pull out the souls of some people hard.
And by the angels who take out the souls of others gently.
And by the angels who move fast, like swimming in the air.
And by the angels who race to do what Allah says.
And by the angels who take care of what Allah tells them.
On the Day when the first loud blast shakes everything.
And the second blast comes after it.
Hearts on that Day will shake with fear.
Their eyes will look down in shame.
They say now: Will we really be brought back to life?
Even after we are old, rotten bones?
They say: That would be a big loss for us! They say it to make fun.
It will be only one loud shout.
And suddenly they will all be awake and standing on the earth.
Allah asks the Prophet: Have you heard the story of Musa?
His Lord called him in the holy valley named Tuwa.
Go to Pharaoh. He has gone too far.
Ask him: Do you want to become clean and good?
And do you want me to show you the way to your Lord, so you will fear and respect Him?
Musa showed him the biggest sign, the great miracle.
But Pharaoh said it was a lie and did not obey.
Then he turned away and worked against it.
He gathered his people and called out to them.
He said: I am your highest lord!
So Allah punished him. He became a lesson for this life and the next.
In this there is a lesson for anyone who fears Allah.
Allah asks: Are you harder to make, or the sky that Allah built?
He made it high and made it just right.
He made its night dark and brought out its light.
After that, He spread out the earth.
From it He brought water and green plants.
And He set the mountains firmly.
All of this is for you and your animals.
But when the biggest shock comes.
On that Day a person will remember everything he worked for.
And Hell will be shown to everyone who can see.
As for the one who went too far.
And chose the life of this world over the next life.
Hell will be his home.
But as for the one who feared standing before his Lord, and stopped himself from bad wants.
Paradise will be his home.
They ask you about the Hour: When will it come?
It is not for you to say when.
Only your Lord knows when it will come.
You are only a warner for people who fear it.
On the day they see it, it will feel like they stayed in this world only for an evening or a morning. It will seem so short.
